invariants.rationale: The returned bucket index is non-negative since it is assigned from totalBuckets, which increments from zero.
fileIdHint is added as a key to updateLocationToBucket inside this method.
The bucket value stored for fileIdHint is exactly the one returned.
A new BucketInfo is put into bucketInfoMap at the key equal to the returned bucket index.
The BucketInfo stored uses fileIdHint as the fileId.
